verses.sanskrit:
शल्य उवाच।
              एवमुक्तः स भगवान् शच्या तां पुनरब्रवीत्। विक्रमस्य न कालोऽयं नहुषो बलवत्तरः ॥१॥
verses.english: Shalya said The god, being thus spoken to, thus addressed Sachi in reply-'This is not the time for (showing) strength, Nahusha is stronger.

verses.sanskrit: विवर्धितश्च ऋषिभिर्हव्यकव्यैश्च भाविनि। नीतिमत्र विधास्यामि देवि तां कर्तुमर्हसि ॥२॥
verses.english: He has grown up to his present position by the virtue of the offerings made him by the Rishis. In this instance, I shall prescribe a politic course and it is proper that it should be followed by you.

verses.sanskrit: गुह्यं चैतत्त्वया कार्यं नाख्यातव्यं शुभे क्वचित्। गत्वा नहुषमेकान्ते ब्रवीहि च सुमध्यमे ॥३॥
verses.english: It should be done by you with secrecy and on no account should you give it out. O you of slender waist, go to Nahusha and speak thus to him.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषियानेन दिव्येन मामुपैहि जगत्पते। एवं तव वशे प्रीता भविष्यामीति तं वद ॥४॥
verses.english: "O lord of the universe, come near me riding a conveyance suitable for the gods and borne by Rishis. By thus showing yourself attached to me, shall I be pleased with you" speak thus to him.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा देवराजेन पत्नी सा कमलेक्षणा। एवमस्त्वित्यथोक्त्वा तु जगाम नहुषं प्रति ॥५॥
verses.english: Being thus spoken to by the king of the gods his queen of lotus-like eyes, replied “Be it so" and went to Nahusha.

verses.sanskrit: नहुषस्तां ततो दृष्ट्वा सस्मितो वाक्यमब्रवीत्। स्वागतं ते वरारोहे किं करोमि शुचिस्मिते ॥६॥
verses.english: Nahusha surprised at seeing her, spoke these words-Welcome to you, O you of beautiful hips, what shall I do, O you of lovely smiles?

verses.sanskrit: भक्तं मां भज कल्याणि किमिच्छसि मनस्विनि। तव कल्याणि यत् कार्यं तत् करिष्ये सुमध्यमे ॥७॥
verses.english: Accept me devoted to you; O blessed one, what do you wish, O maiden of independent spirit? O blessed one, O you of slender waist.

verses.sanskrit: न च व्रीडा त्वया कार्या सुश्रोणि मयि विश्वसेः। सत्येन वै शपे देवि करिष्ये वचनं तव ॥८॥
verses.english: You need not be shy; O you of slender waist, have confidence in me. I swear by truth, O goddess, I shall do your bidding.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्राण्युवाच। यो मे कृतस्त्वया कालस्तमाकाङ्क्षे जगत्पते। ततस्त्वमेव भर्ता मे भविष्यसि सुराधिप ॥९॥
verses.english: The queen of Indra said O lord of the world, I only want time-the favour that has already been accorded to me. After that you shall become my husband, O lord of the gods.

verses.sanskrit: कार्यं च हृदि मे यत्तद्देवराजावधारय। वक्ष्यामि यदि मे राजन् प्रियमेतत् करिष्यसि ॥१०॥
verses.english: The subject that is in my mind is this listen, O lord of the gods; I shall speak it to you, O king, fulfill my desire. The boon, that I demand of you, has connection with your love.

verses.sanskrit: वाक्यं प्रणयसंयुक्तं ततः स्यां वशगा तव। इन्द्रस्य वाजिनो वाहा हस्तिनोऽथ रथास्तथा ॥११॥
verses.english: Indra had for his conveyance, horses, elephants and a car. I wish that you, O lord of the gods should have a conveyance, the like of which was never seen before, which was never owned by Vishnu, nor by Rudra, nor by the Asuras and the Rakshasas.

verses.sanskrit: इच्छाम्यहमथापूर्वं वाहनं ते सुराधिप। यन्न विष्णोर्न रुद्रस्य नासुराणां न रक्षसाम् ॥१२॥
वहन्तु त्वां महाभागा ऋषयः सङ्गता विभो। सर्वे शिबिकया राजन्नेतद्धि मम रोचते ॥१३॥
verses.english: O Lord, to see yourself being borne by the Rishis having good attributes, united together in a palankin, is my wish, oking.

verses.sanskrit: नासुरेषु न देवेषु तुल्यो भवितुमर्हसि। सर्वेषां तेज आदत्से स्वेन वीर्येण दर्शनात् ॥१४॥
verses.english: You should not be (merely) equal to the Asuras or the gods. By your own strength do you absorb that of all beings the moment you set your eyes on them. No one can stand face to face with you, O you powerful being.

verses.sanskrit:
न ते प्रमुखतः स्थातुं कश्चिच्छक्नोति वीर्यवान्। शल्य उवाच।
              एवमुक्तस्तु नहुषः प्राहृष्यत तदा किल। उवाच वचनं चापि सुरेन्द्रस्तामनिन्दिताम् ॥१५॥
verses.english: Shalya said Nahusha, being thus spoken to became well pleased and the king of the gods said these words to that blameless one.

verses.sanskrit:
नहुष उवाच।
              अपूर्वं वाहनमिदं त्वयोक्तं वरवर्णिनि। दृढं मे रुचिरं देवि त्वद्वशोऽस्मि वरानने ॥१६॥
verses.english: Nahusha said 0 you of bright complexion, the conveyance spoken of by you has never before been in existence. I have taken a strong fancy to it O goddess. I am at your disposal, O lovely faced one.

verses.sanskrit: न ह्यल्पवीर्यो भवति यो वाहान् कुरुते मुनीन्। अहं तपस्वी बलवान् भूतभव्यभवत्प्रभुः ॥१७॥
verses.english: The one who makes the Rishis his bearers cannot be of little strength. I am a devotee, strong and lord of what has been, what is to be and what is.

verses.sanskrit: मयि क्रुद्धे जगन्न स्यान्मयि सर्वं प्रतिष्ठितम्। देवदानवगन्धर्वाः किन्नरोरगराक्षसाः ॥१८॥
verses.english: At my being angry the world will be annihilated; everything depends on me. The gods, the Danavas and the Gandharvas, the Kinnaras, the serpents and the Rakashasas, not all of these, not all the world even can stand against me when I am angry. Whoever I see by my eyes, his strength do I absorb.

verses.sanskrit: न मे क्रुद्धस्य पर्याप्ताः सर्वे लोकाः शुचिस्मिते। चक्षुषा यं प्रपश्यामि तस्य तेजो हराम्यहम् ॥१९॥
तस्मात्ते वचनं देवि करिष्यामि न संशयः। सप्तर्षयो मां वक्ष्यन्ति सर्वे ब्रह्मर्षयस्तथा ॥२०॥
verses.english: Therefore O goddess, shall I do your bidding, there is no doubt about it. Seven Rishis shall bear me, Brahmarshis all see, my powers and influence, having thus said to that goddess.

verses.sanskrit:
पश्य माहात्म्ययोगं मे ऋद्धिं च वरवर्णिनि। शल्य उवाच।
              एवमुक्त्वा तु तां देवीं विसृज्य च वराननाम् ॥२१॥
verses.english: Shalya said O king! O you of bright complexion and having dismissed that lovely face one, he yoked, to car, Rishis who used to observe the rules of their class. The habits of his life being unworthy of a Brahmana, having come to the possession of power, vain of his strength, willful and of a vicious nature, he made the Rishis carry him.

verses.sanskrit: विमाने योजयित्वा च ऋषीन्नियममास्थितान्। अब्रह्मण्यो बलोपेतो मत्तो मदबलेन च। कामवृत्तः स दुष्टात्मा वाहयामास तानृषीन् ॥२२॥
नहुषेण विसृष्टा च बृहस्पतिमथाब्रवीत्। समयोऽल्पावशेषो मे नहुषेणेह यः कृतः ॥२३॥
verses.english: Being dismissed by Nahusha, she said to Brihaspati-“But little remains to fulfill in its entirety the boon granted by Nahusha.

verses.sanskrit: शक्रं मृगय शीघ्रं त्वं भक्तायाः कुरु मे दयाम्। बाढमित्येव भगवान् बृहस्पतिरुवाच ताम् ॥२४॥
verses.english: Be quick in hunting out Indra and do me who am devoted to you, a favour and the god Brihaspati said to her-"Be it so."

verses.sanskrit: न भेतव्यं त्वया देवि नहुषाद्दुष्टचेतसः। न ह्येष स्थास्यति चिरं गत एष नराधमः ॥२५॥
verses.english: The evil minded Nahusha need not be feared by you. He will not exist till eternity; indeed he is already gone.

verses.sanskrit: अधर्मज्ञो महर्षीणां वाहनाच्च ततः शुभे। इष्टिं चाहं करिष्यामि विनाशायास्य दुर्मतेः ॥२६॥
verses.english: He is regardless of virtue so to say, having employed the great Rishis as his bearer, O lovely lady; and I shall perform sacrifices for the destruction of this evil minded one. I shall approach Shakra. You need not have any fears, I wish you well.

verses.sanskrit: शक्रं चाधिगमिष्यामि मा भैस्त्वं भद्रमस्तु ते। ततः प्रज्वाल्य विधिवज्जुहाव परमं हविः ॥२७॥
बृहस्पतिर्महातेजा देवराजोपलब्धये। हुत्वाऽग्निं सोऽब्रवीद्राजञ्छक्रमन्विष्यतामिति ॥२८॥
verses.english: Then having lighted up a fire he offered the best offerings in the prescribed form. Brihaspati of great strength, in order to get the gods, having made offerings to Agni (the God of fire) said to him-Oking search out Shakra.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माच्च भगवान् देवः स्वयमेव हुताशनः। स्त्रीवेषमद्भुतं कृत्वा तत्रैवान्तरधीयत॥२९॥
verses.english: From that place, the god (of fire) the consumer of offerings having himself assumed the wonderful form of a female vanished from sight.
verses.bhavadeepa: अन्विष्यतामनुगच्छतु भवान् ॥ इष गतावित्यस्य दिवादे रूपम् ॥२८॥

verses.sanskrit: स दिशः प्रदिशश्चैव पर्वतांश्च वनानि च। पृथिवीं चान्तरिक्षं च विचिन्त्याथ मनोगतिः॥३०॥
verses.english: Having searched in all countries and provinces, mountains and forest, the earth and the sky, with the speed of the mind, he in a moment came back to Brihaspati.

verses.sanskrit: निमेषान्तरमात्रेण बृहस्पतिमुपागमत्। अग्निरुवाच। बृहस्पते न पश्यामि देवराजमिह क्वचित्। आपः शेषाः सदा चापः प्रवेष्टुं नोत्सहाम्यहम् ॥३१॥
verses.english: The god of fire said O Brihaspati, nowhere, in this world do I see the king of the gods. The waters (alone) remain (to be searched). I have never been able to enter the waters.

verses.sanskrit: न मे तत्र गतिर्ब्रह्मन् किमन्यत् करवाणि ते। तमब्रवीद्देवगुरुरपो विश महाद्युते ॥३२॥
verses.english: I have no ingress there O Brahmana, what else shall I do for you. The preceptor of the gods said to him-"O you of great luster, enter the waters."

verses.sanskrit: अग्निरुवाच। नापः प्रवेष्टुं शक्ष्यामि क्षयो मेऽत्र भविष्यति। शरणं त्वां प्रपन्नोऽस्मि स्वस्ति तेऽस्तु महाद्युते ॥३३॥
verses.english: The god of fire said I cannot enter the water there I am destroyed. I throw myself under your protection. O you of great luster, I wish you well.

verses.sanskrit: अद्भ्योऽग्निर्ब्रह्मतः क्षत्रमश्मनो लोहमुत्थितम्। तेषां सर्वत्रगं तेजः स्वासु योनिषु शाम्यति ॥३४॥
